name: video_local_fourier_rm_channel_v1

carrier.state_code: keyed selection of45 balanced RM(1,5) words;32 chips;minimum Hamming16
carrier.local_transform: orthonormal8x8 real Fourier cosine modes; exclude DC and(4,4); all other32 modes used, no band search
carrier.scope: New local carrier, not inherited full-frame FFT or old spatial-DCT success

reference_environment_limit: Same frozen VAE model revision and adapter; previous MP4 was produced in a previous process/environment, and decoded RGB was not retained. Current FLOAT and RGB8 share one decode per arm. Their comparison isolates quantization; comparison with old MP4 is cross-run consistency evidence, not codec-only causality.
evidence_ceiling: Fixed saved-terminal channel localization only. MULTI25..49, local support, codebook, alpha, budget and receiver stay unchanged. FLOAT includes existing VAE decode [0,1] clamp plus deterministic encode. RGB8 applies the exact existing single np.rint uint8 rounding and FP32 /255 to that same decode, with no codec. New reads are channel diagnostics; terminal44 and old MP4 g0 are separate offline references. No new generation, MP4 save/read, global phase search, state acceptance, time-dependent payload, temporal robustness or blind-video closure claim. A finite path argmin is uncalibrated, repeated payload does not choose a path, and old MP4 differences do not isolate codec causality.
